changes.title: Shooting at In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Idaho leaves multiple people dead, police say
changes.summary: Police chief says the shooter is among the dead in ‘very chaotic scene’ near busy shopping area in Twin Falls A shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in southern Idaho on Saturday afternoon left multiple people dead and others injured, police said. The shooter was among the dead, Twin Falls police chief Matthew Hic.

changes.title: Shooting at In-and-Out Burger in Idaho Leaves at Least 3 Dead and 2 Injured, Official Says
changes.summary: A spokesman for Twin Falls cautioned that the number of victims was “expected to be higher.” The police said the shooter was dead.

changes.title: 3 dead, 2 injured in shooting incident in Twin Falls, Idaho
changes.summary: Three people were killed in what police described as an “active shooter incident” around an In-N-Out Burger and other businesses in Twin Falls, Idaho, on Saturday, a city spokesperson said. NBC News’ Valerie Castro reports.
